name: Request Data 2
definition: Contains the meta data for netting cut off update request: message identification, request servicer and a request type.

RequestType.name: Request Type
RequestType.definition: Description of the type of request.

RequestedActivationDate.name: Requested Activation Date
RequestedActivationDate.definition: Specifies the business date on which the new netting cut off(s) is (are) to be activated.

RequestServicer.name: Request Servicer
RequestServicer.definition: Describes the central system servicing the request.

NetServiceParticipantIdentification.name: Net Service Participant Identification
NetServiceParticipantIdentification.definition: Describes the participant issuing the request.

NetServiceType.name: Net Service Type
NetServiceType.definition: Describes the type of netting service supporting the net report.
